name: Wassup in a Minute Trend: Your Own Swaying Anime Character
blurb: The wassup in a minute trend is the TikTok edit where hand-drawn anime characters in baggy streetwear sway side to side, one after another, to a jersey club beat with the line "wassup, been a minute".

prompts.text:
Create a full-body anime character in a polished digital illustration style featuring clean, expressive linework, soft cel shading, subtle gradients, delicate sketch-like textures, realistic anime proportions, natural anatomy, detailed facial features, and carefully rendered clothing folds. Use gentle highlights, smooth skin shading, slightly painterly edges, and refined details for a stylish, semi-realistic anime appearance.
Character: Recreate the person shown in the uploaded image as this anime character: an original drawing of this person, not an existing anime or game character.
Clothing: Accurately reproduce this baggy streetwear outfit, including colors, patterns, accessories, materials, and small details: an oversized glossy black puffer jacket worn open over a plain white T-shirt, a thin silver chain necklace, baggy light-wash jeans with a brown leather belt, and chunky white sneakers. No logos, no brand marks, no sports jersey, no numbers and no letters on any clothing.
Pose: looks a bit to the side while doing money spread: one hand fans out a thick stack of plain green banknotes at chest height, the other hand holds the collar of the open jacket. A calm, cocky half smile with the mouth closed, the face three-quarters to the viewer.
Full Body: Always show the entire character from head to toe. If the uploaded image is cropped or incomplete, intelligently draw all missing body parts, including the torso, arms, hands, legs, and feet, ensuring natural anatomy and consistent proportions.
Background: Completely solid pure white (#FFFFFF), perfectly uniform, with absolutely no gradients, textures, scenery, or objects. Only a soft grey drop shadow falls on the white behind the character and a little to one side, like a cut-out sticker.
Composition: Center the character, keep the entire body visible, and maintain consistent art style and detail throughout. Vertical 9:16: the character fills most of the frame height, with a little white space above the head and below the feet. Exactly one person, an adult. No text, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
The face is always drawn in this anime style, never a photo face: the identity rules below apply to the anime character's face shape, eye color, hair color, hairstyle, bangs, skin tone, glasses, facial hair and gender. The clothes are the streetwear above, not the clothes from the photo.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Kling 3.0, 10 s, 1080p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: Animate the drawn character with the bouncy side-to-side sway of a hand-animated sticker edit, on the beat. Keep the exact same pose, composition, and framing. The whole figure rocks from the feet: it leans a little to the left, then a little to the right, about two sways per second, and the head and shoulders bob along just behind the body with small, cocky nods. The feet stay planted on the same spot. The hand with the banknotes keeps fanning them at chest height and gives them a small flick on the beat; the other hand stays on the jacket collar. Add gentle secondary motion to the jacket, the chain and the hair. The character keeps the calm, cocky half smile with the mouth closed, blinks now and then, and raises the eyebrows once near the end. The face stays the same drawn face from the first frame to the last. Keep the exact same drawing style, linework, shading, colors and outfit, and keep the background completely unchanged: plain white, with the soft drop shadow moving with the body. No camera movement, panning, zooming, or perspective changes. Sound: a bouncy, punchy jersey club beat with fast kicks and claps. No voice, no singing, no words. One continuous shot. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no extra people, no extra hands, no cuts.

prompts.text:
Track the exact camera movement, framing, facial expressions, and body movements from the video. Keep the face, hairstyle, body, clothing, and overall appearance exactly the same as in the uploaded image, with no changes or distortion. Use the background and place of the uploaded image. Keep every move of the in a minute wassup dance from the video in time with the beat: the loose side-to-side sway, the shoulder and hip bounce, and the hand gestures pointing and waving at the camera, from the first move to the last.
Replace the character in the video with the person from the uploaded image. Keep actions, poses, facial expressions and rhythm. Preserve the person's original facial features, maintain character consistency, no distortion, no glitches, no artifacts. The person dances in the place from the uploaded image, in the clothes and shoes from the uploaded image, not the navy t-shirt with a small white logo or the printed pajama pants of the dancer in the video, and keeps their own hair, and their own beard or no beard, from the uploaded image. Follow the dancer's moves and timing exactly: a loose sway with the hands pointing out to the sides, both hands on top of the head with the head down, a step close to the camera with a big smile and both thumbs up, a step back, then the side-to-side sway with the arms out, the hands pointing and waving at the camera, and a small bounce to the end. Keep the body in view, with natural balance and stable ground contact. Exactly one person, no other people. No text, no captions, no logos.

prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: a crew of friends does the in a minute wassup dance at night under a wooden canopy on a paved path, dark trees and bushes behind them, with the same camera, framing, cuts, timing and moves. The ONLY change: [Image 1] replaces the man in the grey beanie and glasses, who starts on the right of the front pair, and [Image 2] replaces the man in the red cap, who starts on the left of the front pair. Only replace these two people; the rest of the crew, the canopy, the moves, the timing, the camera and the cuts stay completely unchanged. Keep everything else the same.

Track the exact camera movement, framing, facial expressions, and body movements from [Video 1]. Keep the face, hairstyle, body, clothing, and overall appearance of each dancer exactly the same as in their own image, [Image 1] or [Image 2], with no changes or distortion. Use the video's background and environment. Keep every move of the in a minute wassup dance from [Video 1] in time with the beat: the loose side-to-side sway, the shoulder and hip bounce, and the hand gestures pointing and waving at the camera, from the first move to the last. Output in 9:16 vertical format.

[Video 1] is for the moves, the crew, the place and the camera only.

Dancer 1 = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY shot: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles). They wear the clothes and shoes from [Image 1]. NO grey beanie and NO glasses unless [Image 1] shows them.

Dancer 2 = the person in [Image 2], in EVERY shot: copy the exact face from [Image 2] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles). They wear the clothes and shoes from [Image 2]. NO red cap and NO sunglasses unless [Image 2] shows them.

The same real people from the first second to the last, so their friends recognize them at once. Never morph, never drift back to the original dancers' faces, and never put their faces on another crew member. Both change: neither of the two front dancers from the video stays.

Shot 1 [0-3.4s]: the two dance side by side at the front, dancer 2 on the left and dancer 1 on the right, both point to the left and bounce, the crew behind them.
Shot 2 [3.4-10.4s]: hard cut: a crew member in a red jacket sways at the front center, the two dance in the crew; from about 7 s dancer 1 sways at the front center, dancer 2 on the right.
Shot 3 [10.4-14s]: hard cut: dancer 2 dances at the front center with the arms out, then a crew member in a white beanie steps to the front and the two dance on in the crew.

One head per person, on that person's own shoulders. A face never appears on knees, legs, hands or clothes. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

Anatomy rules: one head only. Two hind legs and two front legs, no extra legs or paws. Exactly one animal, no people. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
